WITH s0 AS (

  SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week
  WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'),
s AS (
  SELECT cp.category, w.week_ending_date, w.closing_value
  FROM s0 w
  JOIN dim_store ds ON ds.store_key = w.store_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ds.store_id AND st.is_current
  JOIN dim_product dp ON dp.product_key = w.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = dp.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE st.region = 'West' AND st.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
weekly AS (SELECT category, week_ending_date, SUM(closing_value) AS wk_value FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category, ROUND(AVG(wk_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
